title.description: The topic in a few words, as a caller would recognise it ("Opening hours"). Retrieval reads it, and the topic question offers it.

keywords.description: Words and phrases that name the topic exactly (codes, product names). Retrieval matches them as phrases.

asks.description: Example questions a caller asks about the topic, in their words. Retrieval reads them, and the paraphrase tests start from them.

risk.description: regulated: only an approved passage is ever said. low: a later release may let an app answer the long tail in generated wording grounded in approved passages. Default regulated.

text.description: The line said after the answer, from the caller's own data: its variables ({balance}) are fields of the tool's result, which the tool declares (ToolDef.fields).

from.description: The tool that reads the caller's data, a gated read with its own action in policy.yaml. When the gate refuses it, or it finds nothing, the answer is said without this line.

accountLine.description: A line from the caller's own data, said after the approved answer.

additionalProperties.description: One topic of the knowledge base.

description: kb/topics.yaml: the topics callers ask about, by id.
title: DialogWright kb/topics.yaml
